messages:
Maya: Quick sketch for a deterministic onboarding/prioritization grid — posting for fast feedback. TL;DR: three lanes (Quickpass / Standard / Lockdown), numeric score for triage, and pin TTL tiers (14/60/365).

Jorge: Lane definitions?

Maya: Quickpass = public model, low infra delta, <=2pt eval variance, 2-4w. Standard = default path with full harness + staged canary, 8-12w. Lockdown = VPC/regulatory or infra-heavy: KMS+audit, 12+w, paid migration credits.

Sophia: How to score requests?

Maya: Lightweight formula: score = round((impact*revenue_mult)/(infra_cost + stability_risk + kernel_flag)). impact 1-10, revenue_mult 1/3/5, infra_cost 0.1-10, stability_risk 0-10, kernel_flag 0 or 1.5. Sort desc.

Max: Add infra multipliers: +50% if kernel change, +20% for quant tuning, +200% if dedicated HW.

Eva: Include billing worked example — finance will ask.

Maya: Will add. Canary defaults: cohort=min(0.5% tenant traffic,2k req/day), duration 48h gen/72h embed. Auto-halt triggers: p50 > baseline+25ms OR errors +4% OR safety eval drop >2.5pts OR hallucination >1.4x baseline.

Sophia: Add per-tenant anchor prompts (5-10) run during canary/post-rollout to catch customer-specific regressions.

Maya: Pin TTLs: 14 / 60 / 365 days. Pins >60d require paid commitment or reserved capacity. Pin-exemptions allowed with legal+security signoff and capped.

Jorge: Who runs canary?

Maya: Platform orchestrates canary + rollback automation; model owner supplies eval artifacts and signs acceptance. rollout-bot posts updates.

rollout-bot: Canary initiated for model "redwood-beta-v2" on tenant AcmeCorp — cohort=720 req/day, duration=48h, monitoring hooks active.

Maya: I'll convert this into a short RFC + scoring sheet + billing examples and schedule 45m sync. Please react with :+1: or concerns.

Jorge: +1
